question: The Iron Fang was hauling the White Whale’s head back to the capital, but what happened to it after that? Even if they were to keep it as evidence until their claims were proven, how was it disposed of afterwards? Did they burn and bury it, or hang it up for show? Also, the main body that it was cut off from, as well as the fallen great tree; how were they have been disposed of?
answer: The head was used when their claim was evaluated, and afterwards it was rendered to bone and stored in a corner of the royal castle. After a while, if they make a museum, it might get put on display. The main body was burned, and the great tree became lumber.
